english.title: Fail to produce record of aircraft arrivals / departures on demand to officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in control of an aerodrome, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AERODROME..),

(A)_[licensed under an enactment relating to air navigation, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ENACTMENT..),]_
(B)_[when required to do so by the Commissioners]_

failed to

(C)_[keep a record in such form and manner as approved by the Commissioners of all aircraft arriving at or departing from the aerodrome]_
(D)_[keep the record of all aircraft at or departing from the aerodrome available and produce it on demand to an officer together with all other documents kept on the aerodrome which related to the movement of aircraft]_
(E)_[permit an officer to make copies of and take extracts from a record or document required under section 33 of the Customs and Excise management Act 1979]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(3) and (4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
